017package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.console.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
023
024/**
025 * The built-in {@code switcher} card type: a JSON5 body naming {@code views}, each holding one {@code card} or a list
026 * of {@code sections} that each hold a card.  {@code juneau-switcher.js} renders it.  The body is validated by
027 * {@link SwitcherDef#validate(String, Map)}, the same check {@link SwitcherDef} runs, and every nested card is lifted
028 * through its own type's handler by the registry (see {@link CardTypeHandler#nestedCards(JsonMap)}).
029 *
030 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
031 * <p class='bcode'>
032 *    &lt;@card type="switcher" id="revenue-sw" title="Revenue"&gt;
033 *    { views: [ { id: 'chart', label: 'Chart', card: { id: 'rev', type: 'chart', src: '/s', kind: 'line', x: { field: 'd' }, series: [ 'n' ] } } ] }
034 *    &lt;/@card&gt;
035 * </p>
036 *
037 * @since 10.0.0
038 */
039public final class SwitcherCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
040
041   /** Public no-arg constructor, required by {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. */
042   public SwitcherCardType() {
043      // No state; instantiated by ServiceLoader.
044   }
045
046   @Override
047   public String type() {
048      return "switcher";
049   }
050
051   @Override
052   public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
053      if (! source.hasJsonBody())
054         throw source.error("type='switcher' requires a JSON5 body.");
055      var body = source.json();
056      try {
057         SwitcherDef.validate(source.id(), body);
058      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
059         throw source.error("%s", e.getMessage());
060      }
061      var frag = new JsonMap();
062      for (var e : body.entrySet())
063         if (! "visibleWhen".equals(e.getKey()))
064            frag.put(e.getKey(), copy(e.getValue()));
065      return frag;
066   }
067
068   @Override
069   public List<Map<String,Object>> nestedCards(JsonMap body) {
070      var out = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
071      if (body.get("views") instanceof List<?> views)
072         for (var v : views) {
073            if (! (v instanceof Map<?,?> vm))
074               continue;
075            add(out, vm.get("card"));
076            if (vm.get("sections") instanceof List<?> secs)
077               for (var s : secs)
078                  if (s instanceof Map<?,?> sm)
079                     add(out, sm.get("card"));
080         }
081      return out;
082   }
083
084   @SuppressWarnings({
085      "unchecked" // Card maps are JSON objects, so their keys are strings.
086   })
087   private static void add(List<Map<String,Object>> out, Object card) {
088      if (card instanceof Map<?,?> m)
089         out.add((Map<String,Object>)m);
090   }
091
092   // A deep copy, so lifting a nested card never rewrites the authored body.
093   private static Object copy(Object o) {
094      if (o instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
095         var c = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
096         m.forEach((k, v) -> c.put(String.valueOf(k), copy(v)));
097         return c;
098      }
099      if (o instanceof List<?> l)
100         return new ArrayList<>(l.stream().map(SwitcherCardType::copy).toList());
101      return o;
102   }
103}
